# Waves

## Wave properties

A wave transfers energy from one place to another without transferring matter. In a transverse wave the particles of the medium move at right angles to the direction of the wave. In a longitudinal wave the particles move back and forth parallel to the direction of the wave. Sound is a longitudinal wave and cannot travel through a vacuum.

## The wave equation

The frequency of a wave is the number of complete waves that pass a point each second, measured in hertz. The wavelength is the distance between two matching points on neighbouring waves. The speed of a wave equals its frequency multiplied by its wavelength. When a wave moves into a different medium its frequency stays the same but its speed and wavelength change.
